patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; SaneBox is narrower/specialist.

Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; SaneBox is narrower/specialist. Choose Nextiva only if your buying job matches “SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/mo” rather than SaneBox's shape. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than Nextiva's shape. Workflow advantage: Nextiva leans business-phone, customer-messaging; SaneBox leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Nextiva documents a broader use-case set; SaneBox is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Nextiva is SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/month annual, with messaging apps including WhatsApp; SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages.
- Company-size focus: Nextiva (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Nextiva-leaning business-phone, customer-messaging, contact-center vs SaneBox-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Nextiva — Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat.

Limitations — Nextiva: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from $99/mo; SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost.

Poor-fit cases: Nextiva is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included · SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Avoid Nextiva if you actually need SaneBox's motion (SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gma)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
